channel.title: PINNeAPPle Labs · What already shipped, with a date
channel.description: Every line here is a milestone that exists in the repository, with the pull request or the release it came from. We do not announce intentions: when a line goes in, the code is already there.

item.title: Eleven reference digital twins in the library
item.description: Each one with its conservation laws stated and checked: the system stops being an example and becomes a case that can be compared on equal terms.

item.title: Meshless 2-D Navier-Stokes, with the airfoil and the spoiler
item.description: The verification-and-validation solver now runs incompressible flow without a mesh, and the airfoil with a deploying spoiler comes with its reference.

item.title: The .ppx container: a result that reproduces on another machine
item.description: The result, the problem and the environment travel together in one file, each piece hashed. Whoever receives it can re-run without guessing a version.

item.title: Distributed sweeps and the Schwarz PINN
item.description: Campaigns now run split across machines, and a partitioned mesh is solved with one PINN per subdomain instead of a single model for the whole domain.

item.title: pinneapple 0.8.0 on PyPI
item.description: The release ships with the deployment images patched for CVE-2026-111497 and the full history in the changelog.
